about.title: About Di Mana?
about.howItWorksText: A mukim appears highlighted on the map. You name it. If you get it right, the app schedules it further out. If you get it wrong, it comes back sooner.
about.spacedRepetition: This is spaced repetition: the idea that the best time to review something is right before you'd forget it. Instead of cramming, you learn a few mukims at a time and revisit them at increasing intervals.
about.whatsCoveredText: Di Mana? includes all 4 districts and 39 mukims of Brunei Darussalam.
about.dataText: Administrative boundary data from GADM (gadm.org), version 4.1. Map tiles from OpenStreetMap contributors via MapTiler. Interactive map rendered with MapLibre GL JS.
about.maplibreCredit: MapLibre GL JS — Open-source map rendering library
about.fsrsCredit: FSRS — Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler algorithm (ts-fsrs)
about.openSourceText: Di Mana? is open source. Built with Nuxt 3, Vue 3, MapLibre GL JS, Tailwind CSS, and ts-fsrs.
about.privacyText: All your progress is stored locally in your browser. No data is sent to any server. No tracking. No cookies.
